tasks.title: Rounds

hints.spaces: + doesn't add a space. The space after Round is inside the speech marks.
hints.lines: The loop starts at 1 and keeps going while i <= 3. How many laps is that?
To include n, keep going while i <= n (not i < n).
hints.compile: A for line looks like for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) with no semicolon at the end, then { } round the lines to repeat.
hints.timeout: Check the third part of the for brackets: i++ makes i bigger each time, so the loop can finish.
hints.other: Start at 1, not 0, and print i inside the loop.

tasks.title: Countdown in fives

hints.lines: The loop keeps going while the middle part is true. Is 20 <= 0? Counting down, you want to keep going while x is still 0 or more.
hints.timeout: Counting down needs x -= 5. If x keeps getting bigger, it never reaches 0.
hints.compile: Only change the middle part of the for brackets. Keep the semicolons that separate the three parts.

hints.lines: Done! should print once, after the loop. Is it inside the { } by mistake?
hints.spaces: + doesn't add spaces. Put them inside the speech marks: " x " and " = ".
hints.other: Inside the loop: Console.WriteLine(n + " x " + i + " = " + n * i);
